scope: Initial policy-family inventory and focused first-screen review; not exhaustive statute-to-code certification
basis: User-provided first-screen image, earlier BenefitsCal captures and current external official research

rules.implementation_instruction: Use Yes as a self-reported routing fact, not verified eligibility. No/uncertain supports clarification or an official route.
rules.evidence_strategy: Do not request a file in the quick screen.
rules.must_not_conclude: No fixed address or recent arrival is automatic failure.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.implementation_instruction: Reuse relevant evidence; support collateral or alternative proof and unusual-case exceptions.
rules.evidence_strategy: Rent, mortgage, utility or other evidence reasonably establishing residence; no exclusive document type.
rules.must_not_conclude: A uploaded file is county verification or all eligibility is established.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.implementation_instruction: Use estimate for a limited reference; resolve mandatory combinations, excluded members and exceptions before exact calculation.
rules.evidence_strategy: Documents may contribute names, not prove meal arrangements or all mandatory relationships.
rules.must_not_conclude: Everyone on a lease is one SNAP household; separate food always means separate household.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.implementation_instruction: Four-person MCE/BBCE reference is $5,500/month for 2026-10-01 through 2027-09-30. Do not label all above-reference users ineligible.
rules.evidence_strategy: Later obtain income sources, periods, gross/net/YTD distinctions and supported adjustments.
rules.must_not_conclude: A band below the 200% reference proves eligibility or benefit amount.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.topic: Income type, exclusions, self-employment and changes
rules.implementation_instruction: Classify factual income type before selecting a reviewed calculation. No automatic recategorization to improve an outcome.
rules.evidence_strategy: Preserve receipts, gross wages, net pay, year-to-date and user explanations separately.
rules.must_not_conclude: Raw document totals are complete countable household income.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.topic: Categorical eligibility, alternate tests and resources
rules.implementation_instruction: Check pathway applicability before using a negative outcome; full resource/exceptions catalog still required.
rules.evidence_strategy: Do not collect all bank records by default.
rules.must_not_conclude: A generic $5,500 gate applies to every four-person household.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.implementation_instruction: Replace user legal self-assessment with scoped factual branches. Preserve nonapplicant protections and separate CFAP scope.
rules.evidence_strategy: No immigration proof for a nonapplicant; do not infer status from a name or language.
rules.must_not_conclude: Unknown means ineligible; one nonapplicant determines the result for everyone.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.implementation_instruction: Prefer direct official-site entry for sensitive identifiers; implement exceptions before gating.
rules.evidence_strategy: No universal driver-license or Social Security card upload requirement.
rules.must_not_conclude: No photo ID means cannot file.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.implementation_instruction: Prepare truthful expense facts; apply only released deduction rules.
rules.evidence_strategy: Purpose-based supporting evidence; re-use shared records.
rules.must_not_conclude: Every dollar on a utility bill reduces the gross income test.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.implementation_instruction: Add a minimal branch only when student rules apply; California exception source catalog pending.
rules.evidence_strategy: Ask for a relevant record only after identifying the question.
rules.must_not_conclude: Every student is ineligible or needs student proof at intake.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.topic: General work rules and ABAWD time limit
rules.implementation_instruction: Separate general rules, time limit, exemptions and dated waivers. Audit current letters before release.
rules.evidence_strategy: No universal employment-document requirement.
rules.must_not_conclude: Not working automatically disqualifies an applicant.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.implementation_instruction: Keep an urgent-help route available without complete preparation. Detailed predicates require review.
rules.evidence_strategy: Identify allowed verification postponements before implementation.
rules.must_not_conclude: Users should wait for every file before asking for urgent help.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.topic: Filing, signature, interview and verification deadlines
rules.implementation_instruction: Separate filing, complete answers, evidence, interview, submitted and approved states.
rules.evidence_strategy: Requests and receipts have exact person/program/period/deadline provenance.
rules.must_not_conclude: Preparation completion equals official submission or approval.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.topic: Other eligibility restrictions and duplicate participation
rules.implementation_instruction: Reserve explicit inventory coverage for special living arrangements, duplicate participation and applicable restrictions; do not silently treat them as checked.
rules.evidence_strategy: No blanket criminal, immigration or institutional profiling.
rules.must_not_conclude: The four screen questions are a complete eligibility review.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.implementation_instruction: Use initial answer as routing; resolve applicant-specific exceptions before a residency conclusion.
rules.evidence_strategy: No minimum-duration or conventional-address gate.
rules.must_not_conclude: Physical absence today necessarily ends residency.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.implementation_instruction: Use 26-15, not obsolete 26-04/26-04E. The app cannot inspect CalHEERS or CalSAWS verification.
rules.evidence_strategy: For the specified adult category, one recent named California rent/mortgage receipt or utility bill is one listed method; electronic, household-derivation and declaration routes are conditional.
rules.must_not_conclude: Everyone must upload a bill; every adult inherits any other adult document verification; proof is never required.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.implementation_instruction: Identify supported category or withhold a threshold result. Exact dates or diagnoses are unnecessary for the first routing question.
rules.evidence_strategy: Do not import medical records by default.
rules.must_not_conclude: A single income cutoff screens every adult, child and pregnancy-related pathway.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.implementation_instruction: Derive each applicant household through a reviewed method; never copy the CalFresh food group as the answer.
rules.evidence_strategy: Reuse confirmed facts but not household conclusions.
rules.must_not_conclude: All people sharing an address have one MAGI household.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.implementation_instruction: Use category-specific FPL and implementation date; no CalFresh October cycle reuse.
rules.evidence_strategy: Income proof and electronic verification are separate from a comparison.
rules.must_not_conclude: Gross wage band alone is final MAGI or non-MAGI eligibility.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.topic: Non-MAGI resources and special financial rules
rules.implementation_instruction: Index 2026 asset changes and 26-16; obtain and review underlying rules before implementing.
rules.evidence_strategy: Do not request asset evidence from every applicant.
rules.must_not_conclude: Old universal no-asset-test guidance remains correct for every category.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.topic: Immigration, coverage scope and enrollment timing
rules.implementation_instruction: Separate federal funding, state-funded full scope, restricted scope and new/existing enrollment rules. Full decision tree not implemented.
rules.evidence_strategy: Use current applicant-specific instructions, not a shared yes/no immigration verdict.
rules.must_not_conclude: Losing federal full-scope funding automatically means no Medi-Cal coverage.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.implementation_instruction: Detailed 26-18 and reasonable-compatibility review pending. Avoid re-requesting verified facts without a basis.
rules.evidence_strategy: No SSN, credentials or identity-file requirement on quick screen.
rules.must_not_conclude: App confirmation is government verification.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.topic: Application, renewal, continuous coverage and notices
rules.implementation_instruction: Maintain distinct new-application, renewal and update paths; catalog retrospective and continuity rules before use.
rules.evidence_strategy: Use genuine receipts/notices under owner control.
rules.must_not_conclude: A new upload overwrites a submitted snapshot or proves county receipt.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

rules.implementation_instruction: Keep treatment coverage outside baseline eligibility. Refer when evidence is incomplete.
rules.evidence_strategy: Request only the specific relevant notice, not whole medical history.
rules.must_not_conclude: An unusual diagnosis means applying is pointless.
rules.scope: California; federal baseline plus applicable state implementation; county guidance only in its documented scope

screen_mapping.keep: May simplify to program tabs with independent status
screen_mapping.unknown: Keep the other selected program not checked

screen_mapping.keep: Keep with Not sure / help option
screen_mapping.unknown: Clarify only if needed; keep official application route
screen_mapping.issue: Yes is a self-report. A uploaded bill is evidence, not automatic qualification.
screen_mapping.review_basis: Visible screenshot only; dropdown contents and click behavior not inspected

screen_mapping.keep: Keep; clarify include yourself and mandatory groupings
screen_mapping.unknown: Allow Not sure; resolve actual roster later
screen_mapping.issue: Include spouses and under-22 children living with parents even if food is separate. Do not infer from lease membership.
screen_mapping.review_basis: Visible screenshot only; dropdown contents and click behavior not inspected

screen_mapping.visible: Estimated monthly household income before tax
screen_mapping.keep: Keep with named reference and income-uncertainty path
screen_mapping.unknown: No negative eligibility conclusion; prepare income details
screen_mapping.issue: $5,500 is the four-person 200% MCE/BBCE reference, not a universal cutoff. Include explicit zero and unknown states; never default blanks to zero.
screen_mapping.review_basis: Visible screenshot only; dropdown contents and click behavior not inspected

screen_mapping.visible: Could one applicant meet immigration rules?
screen_mapping.keep: Replace legal self-assessment; defer applicant-specific branch for a limited first check
screen_mapping.issue: User cannot be expected to know current legal rules; actual applicants and program-specific status matter.
screen_mapping.review_basis: Visible screenshot only; dropdown contents and click behavior not inspected

reviewed_numeric_reference.name: Gross monthly income reference - MCE/BBCE (200% FPL)
reviewed_numeric_reference.scope: Numeric reference only. Household, income basis and pathway applicability must be separately established. Not a complete benefit calculation.
